content.text: Let me look at the battle screen first.
The battle menu is up. I'll pick FIGHT to attack the wild Rattata.
The menu didn't change after my tap, so I'll press A to confirm FIGHT.
The move list is open. I'll tap SCRATCH.
The battle text is now in the HD box. I'll advance it.
The Rattata fainted. I'll keep advancing the battle text.
The battle ended and the Game Boy screen flashed for a moment again, which is already reported as #10. I'll check the screen now.
The overworld looks heavily blurred right now. I'll take another look to see if that's a transition or permanent.
The blur persists, so I'll note it and keep walking north toward Viridian City.
The overworld stays blurry after the battle. I'll check the frames around the battle end to see what happened.

The contact sheet shows the full-screen Game Boy-style frame (white box with CHARMANDER Lv7 24/24) appearing about 3 seconds after the EXP message. That's the flash already filed as #10, so I'll add these details to that bug rather than file a duplicate.

input.text: Extra detail for #10 (GB flash after wild battle). Sequence in the contact sheet from the Rattata win: 'CHARMANDER gained 24 EXP. Points!' box stays about 2 s, then at about +3.0 s a full-screen grey/white GB-style frame shows, and at about +3.25 s it shows the GB Charmander stat box in the old GB font ('CHARMANDER Lv7 24/24'), before the overworld fades in at about +3.5 s. Also, the overworld stays heavily blurred/washed out for several seconds after the battle (screenshots at turns 18-21), so it may be a leftover transition overlay.

content.text: I'll head around the tree line on the left and continue north.
I'm in Viridian City now. I'll open the menu from the red button to save the game.
The Pokédex shows 1 caught, so #5 may have changed. I'll open the Me tab to find the save option.
The Me tab shows the Saves entry. I'll tap it to save.
This time the save gave a "Saved!" toast, so #7 may be fixed. I'll go back out of the menu.
The blur is still there. I'll ask the developer whether that's intended, then keep heading north.

input.text: Is the heavy blur on the Viridian City overworld intended? Everything except the player sprite looks strongly blurred (like a depth-of-field effect), and it stays on after the Route 1 battle. Also: Me tab 'Played' says 0:20 after a long session, so I want to know whether that's the save time reset or a bug. Also #7 looks fixed: 'Save now' shows a 'Saved!' toast now.

content.text: A sign is directly north, and there's a gap in the ledges to the left. I'll go around the sign through that gap.
The view is sharper here. I'll keep heading north toward Route 2.
I've hit a block: "You can't go through here!" Before deciding what to do, I'll dismiss the box and check the map.
There are NPCs and two houses here. I'll open the Pokédex Map tab to figure out the route north.
The map shows no route north yet. I'll close the menu with the red button at bottom left and look for the opening on foot.
Going up keeps getting blocked with "private property". I'll take a screenshot to see what's in the way.
I'm blocked by a message I can't explain, and the path straight north looks open. I'll ask the developer whether this block is intended before I go further.

input.text: In Viridian City, walking north between the two green-roofed houses (just south of the big dark-tree block up north), I get blocked with 'You can't go through here!' then 'This is private property!'. Two NPCs stand just to the upper-left. Is this an intended block (e.g. the Oak's aide Pokédex check, which needs more Pokémon caught), or a bug? And if it's intended, is there another way north to Route 2? I have 1 caught, 4 seen.
